thread_title: S. rosea 'red lips' Southern Baldwin Co, AL
breadcrumb: S. rosea 'red lips' Southern Baldwin Co, AL

posts.body_html:
Here's a clone that I've had in the collection for a very long time now and it hasn't been fully photodocumented until now! It originated from private property in Southern Baldwin Co, AL, where it is native to. This clone stuck out from the rest because of it's ability to produce side shoots like no other plant from the same population! As a result, over time, these plants can form enormous "tufts" although I haven't really let them get super gigantic.

HEre are some pics of S. rosea 'red lips' Southern Baldwin Co, AL, pics taken during the summer and fall 2022:


Birds eye view of a small clump gaining some size! This was a large, single growth point 2 years ago:








The clumps can get pretty serious! Still, these have been tamed. If not, they could form carpets and colonize a pretty serious amount of space!
